verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a Git forge, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes the hosted service at git.cafe, its MCP endpoint and its beta pricing, with no self-hosted or on-prem distribution. Branch mirroring to another Git server is an adjacent feature and does not count as self-hosting the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
